data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2018 the syndicate carried gross claims outstanding of GBP 411.211m. Analysis of the claims development table shows a net adverse prior-year development of c.GBP 21.37m (5.2% of opening gross claims), driven largely by adverse development in Professional Lines and Energy and by large loss movements including the impact of prior-year catastrophe activity and the reinsurance-to-close activity on the 2016 year. The report also notes significant 2017 catastrophe losses (Harvey, Irma and Maria) and the 2016 year being reinsured to close at a reported loss.
raw_causal_phrases: deterioration of GBP 3.3m (2017: deterioration of GBP 11.5m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on Professional Lines and Energy with partially offsetting favourable developments across the other classes.
In 2017 the Syndicate incurred significant losses from the Harvey, Irma and Maria hurricanes
As part of ASL's non-life underwriting strategy the 2016 year of account has closed by way of a reinsurance to close arrangement into Syndicate 2008

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to Property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development has been calculated from the gross claims development table (claims triangle). The report also references reinsurance-to-close activity on the 2016 year and an explicit reinsurance-to-close loss (GBP 49.3m) which may distort development metrics; narrative references (e.g. a GBP 3.3m deterioration quoted within 'net claims incurred') appear to be net figures and were not used for the gross PYD. The computed gross PYD (+GBP 21.374m) should be treated with caution due to RITC activity and differences between gross and net wording in the narrative.
